title: Python itertools By Example
description: Combine Python's itertools functions into memory-efficient pipelines as you deal cards, analyze stock data, and pick relay teams.
summary: Python’s itertools module is one of the hidden gems of the standard library. Knowing the definitions of its functions isn’t enough, though.
takeaways: Rather than introducing itertools one function at a time, this video course works through practical examples that encourage you to think iteratively: you’ll shuffle and deal a deck of cards, analyze seventy years of S&P 500 prices, and pick relay teams for a community swim club.
Real Python’s Intermediate Python Deep Dive live course covers advanced iteration techniques, special methods, and Python’s object model with an instructor and a small cohort.
The examples in this video course run on Python 3.15.
